## Body

State at close: #239 round 2 pushed at fe6811f6 (91e7d311 base, 5d95807c req-14, fe6811f6 fixes). Round-2 verdicts were pending. Receipts and mutation tables: docs/plans/228-cache-proxy-sidecar/assets/evidence/live-rows.md. Logs in /tmp/ws004-s02 (ephemeral).

Rig that works (no pij seat, no prod port):
- Copy the debug pij-rs out of the shared target (/tmp/...) before proving: target-ws004 is shared with the s03 coder, and its debug/pij-rs gets overwritten. Quote a sha256 as provenance; a reviewer will ask.
- `PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR=<tmp> pij-rs cache-proxy --port 748x` in your own tmux socket (`tmux -L ws004-s02`). Clients: `COPILOT_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=... COPILOT_PROVIDER_MODEL_ID=... COPILOT_PROVIDER_MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS=1000000 copilot -p "..." --model X --allow-all`. Interactive panes for status bars (1.0M window).
- Exporting PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR in your shell keeps test copilots' pij extension from registering with the real daemon, but also breaks `pij-rs ping`; unset it before reading daemon spawns.
- Row 11 (gh logout) without logging out the shared account: a PIJ_GH wrapper that execs real gh on its first run and fails after.
- Count token leaks without printing one: `gh auth token --user X | grep -c -F -f - <files>`. Read quota the same way: `printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "$(gh auth token --user X)" | curl -H @- ...`.
- Premium remaining (copilot_internal/user) lags and the account is shared with the fleet: you cannot isolate a per-turn billing delta. Receipt the initiator split instead and name the gap.

Copilot facts found live (s03 needs them):
- BYOK models are text-only unless COPILOT_PROVIDER_VISION=true; images are silently skipped.
- The wire model defaults to --model, so a `-1m` --model reaches the proxy as `-1m` (the proxy maps it). COPILOT_PROVIDER_MODEL_ID only sets limits and agent config.
- Copilot sends x-interaction-type: conversation-subagent and its own X-Initiator; forward the client's initiator.

What reviewers broke (fix these up front next time):
- A refresh that awaits gh then installs into "whatever holder is current" lets an old account's token land under a new account label. Install only if account AND generation still match; serialise reloads. Test with per-account fixture tokens and a file barrier in the fake gh (hold-<acct>/parked-<acct>/release-<acct>).
- A cached "usable" snapshot clearing a real 402 = flapping ready. Latch the 402; clear only on a 2xx, the reset date passing, or a reload. Split fake controls per endpoint.
- Clearing a cache timestamp to force a re-check made derive() report upstream_unreachable for a moment, which is a spurious state change (prime notice). Use a separate "recheck owed" flag.
- Don't retry a 401 when no newer token exists (failed or latched refresh): it doubles upstream calls.
- reqwest follows redirects by default: set Policy::none() on any client carrying a bearer, with no fallback to Client::default().
- Clone of a rewritten body Vec into Bytes: destructure and move.

Process traps I hit:
- `set -e` / `set -o pipefail` in the persistent bash session persist and silently kill later commands (grep -c 0 matches exits 1). Never set them at top level; use `set +e` if you did.
- Adding a CLI verb also needs: arch-allowlist row + the committed arch fixtures (crates/testkit/fixtures/arch/*.json, edit by hand, ids use /workspace/pij), spawn_sites DAEMON_CRATES, the pinned roster in main.rs clap_exposes_every_ruled_verb, and the SKILL.md native-only table.
- No node_modules in lane worktrees (C25). Run local-path-check, lockfile-allowlist, ddocs-check and biome from the main checkout's node_modules/.bin with cwd = the worktree; list typecheck/lint/vitest as "covered by CI on <head>".
- Mutation receipts: the reviewer asks. Apply each mutation, run the crate's tests through shared-build, revert, record the failing test names. Report one that survives and why, rather than inventing a test.
